Resolve board orientation

Source: R/fct_pipeline.R
resolve_orientation.Rd

Signals are consulted strongest-first (see fct_orientation.R): an explicit user choice, then where the two armies sit, then coordinate labels, with legality only breaking a remaining tie. A wrong 180-degree flip scrambles the whole board, so the chosen orientation is also reported back to the UI along with the signal that decided it.

Usage

resolve_orientation(ctx, symbols, turn, flip_hint, manual = "auto")

Arguments

ctx

A chess.js V8 context from new_chess_context().

symbols

Character vector of 64 recognized symbols, image order.

turn

Side to move, "w" or "b".

flip_hint

Coordinate-label hint from detect_flip().

manual

One of "auto", "white" (white on bottom) or "black".

Value

A list with fen, placement, flip, valid and source (the name of the deciding signal).
